name: Activity list
summary: Likes, follows and mentions grouped under Today and This week, each with drawn avatars and a small badge for its kind, a thumbnail of the post or a Follow back button, new items tinted, and filter chips.
use: on the notifications tab of a social or creator app
a11y: The filter is a native radio group, each day is a labelled section, new items say "New" to screen readers, thumbnails have descriptions, and Follow back is a toggle with aria-pressed.
